findings.recommendation: Close management ports to the Internet: use Azure Bastion or just-in-time VM access and restrict any remaining rule to trusted source prefixes.
findings.remediation_script:
# Human review required. Read-only verification (the agent never runs writes):
az network nic list-effective-nsg -g rg-netops-spoke -n nic-vm-jump -o json
az network nsg rule list -g rg-netops-spoke --nsg-name nsg-netops-app --include-default -o table
az network nsg rule list -g rg-netops-spoke --nsg-name nsg-vm-jump --include-default -o table
# Change (review before running):
# az network nsg rule update -g <nsg-rg> --nsg-name <nsg> -n <allowing-rule> --access Deny
findings.title: SSH (TCP 22) on nic-vm-jump is reachable from the Internet via 20.10.0.4

findings.recommendation: Internet-facing web apps should be protected by WAF: move to the WAF_v2 tier and associate a WAF policy in Prevention mode.
findings.remediation_script:
# Human review required. Read-only verification (the agent never runs writes):
az network application-gateway show -g rg-netops-spoke -n agw-netops --query "{sku:sku,firewallPolicy:firewallPolicy,waf:webApplicationFirewallConfiguration}"
az network application-gateway waf-policy list -g rg-netops-spoke -o table
findings.title: Public Application Gateway agw-netops has no Web Application Firewall (tier Standard_v2)

findings.recommendation: The service accepts traffic from any Internet address (subject to authentication). Set the network default action to Deny with explicit IP/VNet rules, or disable public network access and use private endpoints.
findings.remediation_script:
# Human review required. Read-only verification (the agent never runs writes):
az storage account show -g rg-netops-spoke -n stnetopsdata --query "{pna:publicNetworkAccess,acl:networkRuleSet}"
# Change (review before running):
# az storage account update -g rg-netops-spoke -n stnetopsdata --public-network-access Disabled
findings.title: stnetopsdata: public network access enabled with default action Allow

findings.recommendation: Confirm each open port is an intended public service; prefer publishing through a load balancer or Application Gateway with WAF instead of an instance-level public IP.

findings.recommendation: Public access is limited to the listed IP/VNet rules. If clients use private endpoints only, disable public network access.
findings.remediation_script:
# Human review required. Read-only verification (the agent never runs writes):
az keyvault show -g rg-netops-spoke -n kv-netops --query "{pna:properties.publicNetworkAccess,acl:properties.networkAcls}"
# Change (review before running):
# az keyvault update -g rg-netops-spoke -n kv-netops --public-network-access Disabled
findings.title: kv-netops: public endpoint enabled but default action Deny with 1 IP/VNet rule(s)

findings.recommendation: Unattached public IPs add attack surface if re-attached by mistake and incur cost; delete it if no workload owns it.
findings.remediation_script:
# Human review required. Read-only verification (the agent never runs writes):
az network public-ip show -g rg-netops-spoke -n pip-orphan -o json
# Change (review before running):
# az network public-ip delete -g rg-netops-spoke -n pip-orphan
findings.title: Public IP pip-orphan (20.10.0.6) is not attached to any resource
